<b>Ricchezza</b> (N. specie, N. taxa): q: Richness (No. of species, No. of taxa): how many different taxa. Shannon: grows with the number of taxa and with how evenly they are spread (0 = a single taxon). Simpson (from 0 to 1): the probability that two reads taken at random come from different taxa.
Kraken mostra solo i taxa con almeno lo: Kraken shows only taxa with at least {soglia} % of the reads assigned by Bracken (unclassified reads excluded; confidence {confidence}). With the recommended settings for the full PlusPF (confidence 0.5 and threshold 0.1 %), in the simulated communities the false species above 0.1 % drop from 196 to 64 across 12 samples, and in the Zymo control sample from 10 to 0. Taxa below the threshold, including Listeria monocytogenes, do not appear in the Kraken profile: Listeria needs a targeted test.
MetaPhlAn non usa soglie, ma con molto D: MetaPhlAn uses no threshold, but with a lot of host DNA few reads of the taxa are left and rare taxa can be missed. In the simulated communities, Listeria monocytogenes at 0.1 % was found with about 1,800 of its read pairs and missed with about 900; with 95 % host (about 150,000 read pairs of taxa) bacteria up to 0.4 % were missing.

<b>Come leggerle.</b> Q30 vuol dire al m: How to read them. Q30 means at most 1 error every 1,000 bases: the higher the percentage, the better the reads, and after fastp it goes up because the worst parts were removed. Many duplicates mean many copies of the same molecule (little starting DNA or a lot of PCR). Duplicates are measured on the raw reads. The mean length is the one after fastp. The more host DNA is removed, the fewer pairs are left for the profiles: with few pairs rare taxa can be missed (section 2).

Nelle feci il DNA umano è di solito poco: In faeces there is usually little human DNA, but it is always removed: it says nothing about the taxa and it protects the person's privacy. MetaPhlAn and Kraken know the taxa of the human gut well.
Sulla pelle i taxa sono pochi: il DNA um: On the skin there are few taxa: human DNA can be a large part of the reads and DNA from reagents and from the laboratory weighs a lot. Read the rare taxa only next to a negative control (extraction blank).
Suolo o rizosfera (anche del vigneto): Soil or rhizosphere (also from a vineyard)
Qui non c'è un ospite: toglierò solo il: There is no host here: I will remove only the human DNA, which comes from the people who collected and handled the sample.
Nel suolo la gran parte delle specie non: In soil most species have no reference genome: MetaPhlAn recognises few of them and Kraken leaves many reads without a name. The profile describes the known taxa, not the whole community.
Toglierò il DNA della vite e quello uman: I will remove the grapevine DNA and the human DNA.
Nel mosto c'è DNA dell'acino e nessuno d: Must contains DNA from the berry and neither database contains the grapevine: if it is not removed, those reads are wrongly assigned to some taxon. Many must yeasts (Hanseniaspora, Metschnikowia, Aureobasidium) are in neither database: the profile does not see them.
Sulla buccia i taxa sono pochi e il DNA: On the berry skin there are few taxa and grapevine DNA can be most of the reads: many reads are needed to get a profile. The grapevine genome used also contains the chloroplast and the mitochondrion, which are removed together. Many yeasts of the berry skin (Hanseniaspora, Metschnikowia, Aureobasidium) are in neither database: the profile does not see them.
Nella foglia il DNA della pianta è di so: In the leaf the plant DNA is usually most of the reads: many reads are needed to get a profile. The grapevine genome used also contains the chloroplast and the mitochondrion: they are removed together, otherwise chloroplast reads can look like cyanobacteria.
Sulla radice, e ancora di più al suo int: On the root, and even more inside it, there is a lot of grapevine DNA: for this reason some studies do shotgun sequencing only on the root surface and on the surrounding soil. For the soil around the root choose 'Soil or rhizosphere'.
